∀ {Feature : Type u_1} {Base : Type u_2} {Equilibrium : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Feature]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Feature] [Nonempty Base] (skillGivenBase : Equilibrium → Base → PMF ℝ)
  (baseProfile : Equilibrium → PMF Base) (M : Base → GaussianOffsetSignalFamily Feature) (theta : Base → Feature → ℝ)
  (k : Feature) (accessFraction baseOnlyEstimate : Equilibrium → Base → ℝ)
  (scoreLaw : Equilibrium → Base → GaussianScaleLaw),
  (∀ (e : Equilibrium) (base : Base), 0 ≤ accessFraction e base) →
    (∀ (e : Equilibrium) (base : Base), accessFraction e base < 1) →
      (∀ (base : Base) (test : ℝ) (action : LG21AccessAction),
          (paperSchoolInformationSetFromAccessAction false base test action).accessStatus = none) ∧
        ∀ (e : Equilibrium),
          ∃ W,
            (∀ (base : Base) (skill : ℝ), W.takes base skill) ∧
              (∃ base score, ¬W.reports base score) ∧
                (∀ (base : Base), ∃ cutoff, ∀ (score : ℝ), W.reports base score ↔ cutoff ≤ score) ∧
                  ¬lg21SourceLawLatentSkillFair
                        (paperBaseMixedGaussianPosteriorLawSurface (skillGivenBase e) (baseProfile e) M theta k
                          (scoreLaw e) (baseOnlyEstimate e)) ∧
                    ¬lg21SourceLawObservablyFair
                          (paperBaseMixedGaussianPosteriorLawSurface (skillGivenBase e) (baseProfile e) M theta k
                            (scoreLaw e) (baseOnlyEstimate e)) ∧
                      ¬lg21SourceLawDemographicallyFair
                          (paperBaseMixedGaussianPosteriorLawSurface (skillGivenBase e) (baseProfile e) M theta k
                            (scoreLaw e) (baseOnlyEstimate e))

nodes.value:
fun {Base} skillGivenBase baseProfile intercept slope testScale noAccessEstimate hslope htestScale =>
  { Equilibrium := PUnit.{u_2 + 1},
    latentAccessLaw := fun x skill base =>
      LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.gaussian
        (lg21OneTestPosteriorScoreLaw (intercept base) (slope base) ⋯ skill (testScale base) ⋯),
    latentNoAccessLaw := fun x x_1 base => LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.point (noAccessEstimate base),
    observableAccessLaw := fun x base =>
      LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.skillGaussianMixture (skillGivenBase base) fun skill =>
        lg21OneTestPosteriorScoreLaw (intercept base) (slope base) ⋯ skill (testScale base) ⋯,
    observableNoAccessLaw := fun x base => LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.point (noAccessEstimate base),
    demographicAccessLaw := fun x =>
      LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.baseSkillGaussianMixture baseProfile skillGivenBase fun base skill =>
        lg21OneTestPosteriorScoreLaw (intercept base) (slope base) ⋯ skill (testScale base) ⋯,
    demographicNoAccessLaw := fun x => LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.basePointMixture baseProfile noAccessEstimate,
    baseOnlyLaw := fun x base => LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.point (noAccessEstimate base),
    fullFeatureLaw := fun x base test =>
      LG21SkillBaseMixtureEstimateLaw.gaussian
        (lg21OneTestPosteriorScoreLaw (intercept base) (slope base) ⋯ test (testScale base) ⋯) }
